alternative_interpretations: The monkey may simply be a companion animal in an urban setting, with no performative intent implied by the visual evidence alone.
limitations: No signage, audience behavior, or explicit performance cues confirm entertainment context; vest and leash could serve practical purposes.

alternative_interpretations: The woman may be texting or checking messages; her orientation does not definitively prove active recording.
limitations: Phone screen is not visible; orientation alone cannot confirm recording versus other usage.
